title: Naked and Afraid
description:
21 Miles, 21 Days
In a lethal African hunting ground, a biker chick and a taxidermist have to stay on the move to survive; the pair must push across 21 miles of savanna to find food and water while avoiding a pride of lions that's tracking them every step of the way.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E10 — Trying to Deal with the Devil
Deep in Mexico's Baja desert lies the scorching wasteland of the Devil's Canyon; a Canadian mountain man teams up with an experienced homesteader to take on the canyon's triple-digit heat, scarce water, and venomous predators.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E12 — Shaken and Very Stirred
A powerful earthquake in the Philippine jungle rattles a thrill-seeking chef and a competitive hockey mom, but the territorial monkeys, rainstorms, lack of food, and dehydration lead to a disastrous face-first fall.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S11 E09 — Blood, Sweat and Fears
Two survivalists are back for redemption in the Mexican jungle but torrential downpours, competing survival styles and a machete accident threaten to send them home early again.

A married couple goes from watching the challenge from their couch in Idaho to taking it on in the perilous Philippine jungle; torrential rain, relentless bugs and deadly boars put their survival skills and their marriage to the ultimate test.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
Don't Cave In
In the relentless Colombian jungle, a mom and National Guard vet teams with a firefighter; violent storms and hypothermic conditions force them to huddle in bat-infested caves; a special bond develops between a survivalist and a wild monkey.

title: Animal Cribs
description:
S01 E07 — Superfly Parrot Palace
The Brewer family's home doubles as a rescue for dozens of parrots; Antonio helps a family reclaim their kitchen and dining room, and builds a huge geodesic dome for rescue parrots to spread their wings.

title: Animal Cribs
description:
S01 E09 — Fluffy Fixer Pupper
Antonio designs a multi-functional space for the bunnies, ferrets, cats and dogs that live under one roof.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E04 — Terror in Paradise
On a family trip to Pattaya, Thailand, Helen Costigan attends an elephant show when one of the massive beasts turns deadly; golf ball recovery specialist Scott Lahodik is diving in a Florida lake when he's attacked by a vicious alligator.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E03 — Backyard Bite
Outside Corpus Christi, Texas, Jeremy Sutcliffe is working in his garden when a rattlesnake bite puts him on the brink of death; while spearfishing in the Bahamas, Kent Bonde is blindsided by a bull shark that tears the calf muscle from his leg.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E06 — Safari Horror
Bob Legasa is hunting in Montana and what he thinks is a bluff charge from a grizzly bear is, in fact, a near-lethal attack; while canoeing in Zimbabwe, Kristen Yaldor is thrown into the water and finds herself in the jaws of a hippopotamus.

title: I Was Prey
description:
S03 E02 — Grisly Encounters
Jordan Carbery is investigating a noise outside his cabin and encounters a massive grizzly bear; Zanele Fox and her husband take a river tour when she is thrown from her raft and ravaged by a crocodile.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E03 — Killer Bees Attack
The Venom One team stages a rescue when deadly bees threaten an elderly living facility.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S02 E01 — A Python Ate My Pet
The Venom One team encounters a python with a possible family pet in its stomach.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E06 — Foreign Invasion
Chuck and Ernie head to Costa Rica in search of the black-headed bushmaster, a large, venomous pit viper.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E04 — Alaska's Cold Water Killer
A recent fatal incident in the Alaskan wilderness sends Jeremy on a quest for possible suspects that culminates in a showdown with an unexpected, bizarre water beast.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E05 — South Pacific Terrors
Jeremy Wade fights through tropical storms and dangerous jungles to search for a Fijian killer that has been part of the local folklore for years, but there may be more than one.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E01 — Canadian Horror
Jeremy Wade investigates rumors of a twenty-foot lake monster that attacks people; with snakes, freshwater sharks and giant sturgeon unlikely possibilities, the answer as to what it is drives Jeremy crazy.

title: River Monsters
description:
S06 E05 — Bone Crusher
Wade faces one of his greatest fears to uncover increasing missing persons cases.

title: River Monsters
description:

Wade hunts for the Lau-lau, a creature said to swallow men whole.

title: River Monsters
description:
S06 E02 — Jungle Terminator
Wade teams up with a local tribe to solve three mysterious deaths in three different South American countries.

title: River Monsters
description:

Wade is on the hunt to find out what was behind the Sobral Santos attack on the Amazon River, where more than 200 passengers were killed on a pitch-black night.

description:

The rivers of Guyana may host a real freshwater mermaid that the locals call the Water Mama.

S01 E08 — Ultimate Builds
Antonio Ballatore showcases a number of incredible pet-centric builds that have inspired his own creations.

title: Animal Cribs
description:
S02 E01 — Dog Town, USA
Antonio helps a family who opened their home to neighborhood dogs create the ultimate backyard dog park with custom dog houses, a paddling pool for hot summer days, and a slick structure of ramps and tunnels to keep everyone entertained and active.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E01 — Slimy Is the New Fuzzy
The Georgia Aquarium sends a team to Cape Town, South Africa, to help rehabilitate and release a group of African penguins into the wild; a dive team installs a shipwreck feature into an exhibit to provide enrichment for their sea turtle.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E02 — Seal the Deal
Two African penguins, Freya and Neo, welcome a young chick, but there's cause for concern when health problems arise; staff work to train a trio of harbor seals to ride the elevator, with the only hiccup being a nervous seal named Floyd.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S01 E04 — Otter Tale
Beloved Asian small-clawed otter Pinkie has a recurring bloody nose, the team goes to great lengths to find out what could be causing it; feisty baby American alligators arrive at the aquarium and must learn to eat in an orderly way.

title: Tanked
description:
S02 E05 — Tanks for the Memories
Wayde and Brett recall their favorite projects from the first season and share never-before-seen footage.

title: Tanked
description:
S02 E04 — Roll With It
The Pensacola Blue Wahoos ask Wayde and Brett to turn an old school bus into a mobile fish tank; Brett comes up with a unique tank design for his mother's nail salon.

title: Tanked
description:
S02 E07 — Most Challenging Tanks
Brett and Wayde recall the toughest tank builds from the show's first season.

title: Tanked
description:
S02 E08 — Where the Wild Things Are
The CEO of a national pet-supplies chain desires a massive tank for a diverse selection of animals; a tank is needed for a business venture between rock band Kiss and Monster Mini-Golf.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E03 — Nature's Super HQ
Pete and NTS build a tree house for the For-Mar Nature Preserve just outside Flint, Mich.; the 5-platform nature headquarters serves as a positive addition to a community still reeling from the water crisis that began in 2014.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E09 — Magical Modern Treehouse
Busy film industry clients in Fayetteville, Ga. request a treehouse on their exuberant 63-acre plot of land, inspired by mid-century architecture and equipped with a zip line; Pete swings by the treehouse of Dale Earnhardt Jr.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S07 E01 — Bon-Appé-Treehouse
Surrounded by fields of red poppies and intertwined within a giant live oak, Pete creates a dining room tree house with a Provence countryside feel as part of a French restaurant.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S07 E08 — Zac Brown's Space Crab
Pete builds a half spaceship, half horseshoe crab, zinc-wrapped treehouse at state-of-the-art kids camp, Camp Southern Ground, at the request of country music superstar Zac Brown.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S07 E06 — Swiss Family Surprise
Pete builds a Swiss Family Robinson inspired treehouse in Michigan to help a man surprise his wife for their anniversary; Inspired but far more advanced than the original.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S07 E03 — How 'bout Them Apples
Pete constructs a tasting room, high above the apple orchards, for Walden, N.Y., hard cider company Angry Orchard.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S06 E05 — View From Above III
Pete and his crew reminisce about their adventures and answer questions from fans.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S08 E01 — Appalachian Christmas Treehouse
Pete and his crew trek to the Blue Ridge Mountains to build a tree house for one of their own, carpenter Mike Reynolds; sitting 16 feet high, it makes the perfect rustic guesthouse to host the raucous Appalachian Breaking Up Christmas tradition.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:

description:
S04 E08 — Paint You Later, Alligator
The boys dress up in medieval costumes and hunt for an alligator on the grounds of a Renaissance fair; Tre decides to become a professional artist like Ashley.

title: Gator Boys
description:
S04 E09 — Monster Croc Rescue
Paul and Ashley train Kayla to become an alligator wrestler; Jimmy and the volunteers square off against a 17-foot crocodile at a new park in Tampa.

title: Hard Truths of Conservation
description:
S04 E12 — A Wilder Harvest
How important is the wild harvest to communities in North America? Dan Cabela travels from Kansas to Newfoundland in search of the answer, meeting communities who rely on the yearly cycle.

title: Nature's Strangest Mysteries: Solved
description:
S01 E06 — Zombie Spider
A look at the possibility that zombie spiders are real and why would a pod of beluga whales adopt a unicorn of the sea.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E05 — Slow Loris Romance
The slow loris has a tiny window for breeding, so staff anxiously help a potential pair connect; the veterinary team develop ground-breaking techniques to treat the stoic pigeons; an okapi with a limp gets a helping hand.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E08 — Training Dragons
The squirrel monkeys play hard-to-get with the Children's Zoo's keepers; a pair of Komodo dragons meet for the first time, with explosive results; the Inca terns prepare for their first big flight.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E02 — The Tiger's Dance
When keepers introduce two tigers as potential mates, the process proves bumpy; a pair of African porcupines arrive at the zoo, requiring delicate handling; a pregnancy check on a 3,000-pound rhino necessitates some highly specialized equipment.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E04 — An Elephant's Trust
Trust and experience are put to the test when an elephant requires delicate veterinary treatment from her keepers; endangered pink pigeons need all the help they can get to produce offspring; Monty the adorable otter needs to visit the dentist.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E07 — The Eagle Has Landed
A pregnant African wild dog has the staff anxiously preparing for the big day; zoo director Jim Breheny steps in to help a keeper learn how to handle a golden eagle; a new tree in Jungle World gives the gibbons a fresh world to explore.

title: The Zoo
description:
S02 E10 — A Gorilla With Heart
Surgery on a silverback gorilla's broken canine reveals a more serious medical issue; love develops between two birds-of-paradise; dozens of venomous tarantulas keep the staff on their toes.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E04 — On the Edge
Two sisters rush their tiny dog to the clinic with a life-threatening brain injury; a dog with a broken jaw perplexes Dr. Jeff; a fearless cat with a broken leg wins the admiration of the clinic staff; the team treats some uncooperative yaks.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E07 — Picking Up the Pieces
A boxer kicked in the head by a horse requires urgent surgery to repair its skull; Dr. Jeff helps a woman with a rapidly expanding feral cat colony in her backyard; Dr. Baier preps for delicate surgery on a beloved ferret with a facial growth.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E06 — Shelter From the Storm
Dr. Jeff must act fast to save a bulldog after a life-threatening accident; when devastating floods hit Louisiana, Dr. Jeff sends vet tech Hector to rescue pets left homeless in the disaster; Dr. Don operates on a cat with a bad habit.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E10 — Unlucky Break
Dr. Jeff and Dr. Kraft take on a challenging shoulder break while Dr. Petra gets a cat off the hook; Dr. Baier and Dr. Jeff pitch in at a wolf sanctuary and Dr. Kraft helps a Rottweiler with a scary condition.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E08 — Friends for Life
Dr. Jeff battles to fix a German shepherd's broken elbow and get him back to his worried owner, a disabled war veteran; a cat with a swollen bladder needs difficult surgery to save its life; Drs. Baier and Hector head to an exotic bird sanctuary.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E09 — Never Give Up
Dr. Jeff and his team head to Mexico to help pets and their owners; Dr. Jeff treats a dog with a painful-looking growth; Dr. Petra and Dr. Nichols help a dog seriously injured in a fight; the team tries to catch and treat a pack of feral dogs.

title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
description:
S03 E11 — A Fighting Chance
Dr. Jeff must perform surgery on a cherished Doberman to remove a large mass; Dr. Baier treats a 10-year-old cockatiel having trouble breathing; Dr. Don helps a playful puppy with a broken elbow.

description:
S02 E06 — Down to the Wire

Jimmy causes major friction with Paul by buying a restaurant while they are already stretched thin by road shows and a new juke joint.

description:
S16 E02 — Bobcat on the Loose
A call is made about two bobcats on the loose and Officer McKee must track them down before things escalate; a fisherman is caught concealing his unregistered snowmobile; Officer Cyrs rushes to the site of a head-on snowmobile accident.

title: North Woods Law
description:
S16 E05 — Don't Tread on Me
An investigation over unattended fishing lines takes a turn when it's discovered that the fisherman was arrested for shooting his friend; over in Colebrook, a snowmobiler is confronted for riding across a landowner's property without permission.
